description: Compare the machines of any number of an experiment's clusters, each over its own window: a leaderboard, distributions, an overlay by hours since each cluster's start, and a timeline over the experiment's span. Reads host metrics and eBPF only, so it works whatever database runs on the hosts. The dashboard range stays relative; panels on absolute time cover the experiment's span on their own.

links.title: System A/B Comparison
links.tooltip: Two clusters of this experiment, side by side

panels.description: One row per selected cluster. Every figure is that cluster's own average over its own window, from its first to its last report of host metrics (the steps where it sent nothing are skipped), so clusters that ran on different days compare directly. Values are raw; click a header to sort by it. Green is better for every coloured column but Network per host. The Cluster column links to System Overview over the cluster's window and to System A/B Comparison with the cluster as A.
